claims.text: The same reference list names the Manager of the Albuquerque Operations Office in 1957 as Hertford, at reference 202, 'Hertford, K., Manager, Albuquerque Operations'. Gise's own 1957 memorandum is addressed to that office from AEC headquarters, not written from it.
